open-failed: Error when the chat couldn't be loaded and the server gave no message.
failed: Under the heading when the chat couldn't be opened.
about.loading: Under the heading while the chat loads.
about.since: End of the line under a chat's heading: {{when}} is when the chat started, a date and time. The _archived form says the chat was archived. "Read-only": an admin can read but not write here.
about.room: Line under a room's heading. "Room" is a product noun (a chat with several people and socios). {{socios}} names its socios (about.names or about.no-socio), {{people}} its people (about.names, maybe about.invited), {{since}} is about.since.
about.no-socio: In about.room's {{socios}} when the room has no socio now.
about.chat: Line under a private chat's heading: {{socio}} the socio's (AI agent's) name, {{owner}} the person's name or a team's, {{since}} is about.since.
about.removed-socio: In place of a deleted socio's name.
about.gone-owner: In place of the name of a person no longer in the workspace.
about.admin: A room member's name marked as a room admin.
about.nobody: In about.room's {{people}} when nobody is in the room.
about.invited: {{people}} is the members' names (about.names or about.nobody); {{count}} how many invitations are still open.
note: Notice above the chat. <link> wraps a link to the access log, the list of who opened what. The _room form is for a room (a chat with several people).
load-earlier: Button that loads earlier turns (answers from a socio) of the chat.
empty: In place of the turns (answers from a socio) when the chat has none finished yet.
showing-more: Screen-reader status: how many turns are shown, and there are earlier ones to load.
showing-all: Screen-reader status: how many turns are shown, which is every one.
grounding.title: Heading of a collapsed panel that lists what pages and datasets this chat's answers read ("grounded": used as the basis of an answer).
grounding.subtitle: Beside the panel's heading, lowercase.
audit.title: Heading of a collapsed panel listing who joined, left, was invited or refused in this room.
audit.subtitle: Beside the panel's heading, lowercase.
